newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Air cargo volumes rising in former Soviet states-ACI EUROPE.
newsitem.headline: Air cargo volumes rising in former Soviet states-ACI EUROPE.

text.p: Air cargo volumes handled in 1996 by airports in Russia and other countries of the former Soviet Union rose to 549,000 tonnes, 17 percent up on 1995 but only a quarter of the 1991 figure, ACI Europe said in a statement on Monday.
Freight and mail volumes fell from 2,250,000 tonnes in 1991 to lows of 470,000 in 1994 and 1995, the Airports Council International said.
"The international share of air freight transport has grown from under 100,000 tonnes in 1991 to almost 250,000 tonnes in 1995 and 310,000 tonnes in 1996," ACI said.
Leading foreign operators in the air freight market included Lufthansa and KLM, said ACI, which says it speaks on behalf of 344 airports in 48 European countries.
Express cargo market services, faced with no local competition, are provided by DHL, UPS and TNT, it added.
